cards.title: How Amplifiers Work
cards.description: An amplifier takes the weak electrical signal from your guitar pickup and amplifies it to drive speakers, making your guitar audible and shaping its tone in the process.
items: Preamp: Shapes and colors the tone
Power amp: Provides volume and dynamics
Speaker: Converts electrical energy to sound waves
